measurement_limits: Browser runs on AWS through the public HTTP origin and TURN; this does not measure the user device or network.
Initial 1080p-baseline, 4k-navigation and 4k-person engine distributions use camera telemetry at target 10 Hz. Later variants identify per-frame Unreal CSV timing.
The four-drone experiment explicitly selects 1 Hz per drone. Production mission capture cadence has not been established.
Other active containers are recorded per run. The shared host includes snr-unreal-world; these results do not establish isolated host capacity.
The current grass is temporary. Replacement assets require another performance gate.
The approved Rocketbox characters have mesh hair, not MetaHuman grooms. Their category labels do not establish exact ages.

gpu_cgroup_update.diagnosis: A CPU quota update removed NVIDIA device access with the legacy runtime hook. A disposable container reproduced NVML exit 255 immediately after the update; explicitly requested device nodes retained access.
gpu_cgroup_update.status: Device nodes declared by tracked launcher; recreated renderer is ready at 12 CPUs

measurement_failures.failure: CSV parser rejected a final row containing FrameTime but no completed CPU/GPU timing. The failed run and raw CSV are preserved. Independent analysis excludes only that final incomplete row and records it explicitly.
measurement_failures.status: This run also missed the browser FPS and GPU p95 gates.

measurement_failures.outcome: Host became unresponsive and subsequently rebooted. Cause unconfirmed. Interrupted run is not accepted; drone cleanup was interrupted by SIGTERM.

user_deferred_grass.effect: No further tuning or combination of the current grass assets. Existing comparisons are retained. Final performance must be checked with the replacement assets.

session_wait.reason: Public readiness reports occupied, one DefaultStreamer player; character coverage preflight stopped without opening a browser

capture_client_lifetime.diagnosis: A new MessagePack connection was created for each capture, retaining active socket read loops and large decode buffers. The bridge now reuses one connection per thread. This measured leak is consistent with the earlier host stall; that stalled host has no retained OOM record.
